text: APPROVE. The extraction moves the nested foreach, try/catch, inner foreach and if (the bulk of the nesting-weighted complexity) out of `CollectAsync`, taking it well below 15; the moved code is verbatim, including the `CHA0004` pragma pair and `ConfigureAwait(false)`, so behaviour is unchanged. The one thing I couldn't confirm from the diff is that `lockfiles` is declared as `List<string>`, which the new helper's signature assumes. That is likely given its `.Count` use, but not shown.
